key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 12!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 12!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果リードアウト12を手に入れた!

key: Info on Desert Field now available!
en: Info on Desert Field now available!
ja: デザートフィールドの情報が閲覧可能になった!

key: Okay, one more time. Some moves can temporarily create Field Effects in addition to their regular usage.
en: Okay, one more time. Some moves can temporarily create Field Effects in addition to their regular usage.
ja: よし、もう一回説明するぞ。一部のわざは通常の効果に加えて、一時的にフィールド効果を作り出すことがある。

key: These moves are...
en: These moves are...
ja: そのわざというのは……

key: Ion Deluge, Topsy Turvy aaaand... was it Mist?
en: Ion Deluge, Topsy Turvy aaaand... was it Mist?
ja: プラズマシャワー、さかさバトル、あとぉ……しろいきりだったか?

key: Yes! Okay, I knew it.
en: Yes! Okay, I knew it.
ja: よし!やっぱりそうだった。

key: Field Effects won't be created if the user of those moves is holding an Everstone, but it'll be extended if they hold an... Amplifield Rock?
en: Field Effects won't be created if the user of those moves is holding an Everstone, but it'll be extended if they hold an... Amplifield Rock?
ja: そのわざを使うポケモンがかわらずのいしを持っているとフィールド効果は発生しないが、アンプリフィールドロックを持っていれば効果が延長される……だったか?

key: Got it! I'm gonna ace this test!
en: Got it! I'm gonna ace this test!
ja: よし、わかった!このテスト、満点間違いなしだ!

key: Huh? What's this?
en: Huh? What's this?
ja: ん?これは何だ?

key: This is from that girl?
en: This is from that girl?
ja: あの子からか?

key: I see... I had no idea she felt this way.
en: I see... I had no idea she felt this way.
ja: なるほど……そんな風に思われてたなんて知らなかった。

key: Well, that's flattering, but...
en: Well, that's flattering, but...
ja: まあ、光栄だけど……

key: I guess I'll have to go down and be straight with her later.
en: I guess I'll have to go down and be straight with her later.
ja: 後で下に行って、彼女にちゃんと本当のことを話さないとな。

key: Oh, maybe that's a poor choice of words?
en: Oh, maybe that's a poor choice of words?
ja: ああ、それは言い方がまずかったか?

key: Anyway, you should hang onto the chocolate.
en: Anyway, you should hang onto the chocolate.
ja: とにかく、そのチョコレートは持っておいてくれ。

key: It would be rude if I ate it and then let her down.
en: It would be rude if I ate it and then let her down.
ja: 食べておいて彼女を振るなんて、失礼にあたるからな。

key: Hey, you ever think about running away?
en: Hey, you ever think about running away?
ja: なあ、逃げ出したいと思ったことはあるか?

key: To live solely on your own strength and that of your Pokémon...
en: To live solely on your own strength and that of your Pokémon...
ja: 自分とポケモンの力だけで生きていくっていうのは……

key: It's romantic, right? I can't get that idea out of my head.
en: It's romantic, right? I can't get that idea out of my head.
ja: ロマンチックだろ?その考えが頭から離れないんだ。

key: You should hang onto that chocolate.
en: You should hang onto that chocolate.
ja: そのチョコレートは持っておいてくれ。
